executionFacts: Tests used isolated temporary projects and independent loopback services.

The 93-test complete run exercised project-owned Chrome through 16 browser runtime tests. Two further browser lifecycle tests were added after this run loaded its test files; their validation belongs to the runtime executor's final record.
The initial default-sandbox run could not bind loopback (EPERM); the isolated loopback rerun was approved.

The first full run reported 88 of 93 passing: one browser fixture was being updated, and four existing HTML tests used aliased /var temporary paths. The final run rebuilt current sources and used command-local TMPDIR=/private/tmp.
User whiteboard data and its existing service were outside the test fixtures.
